author: John Murphy, KOMU 8 Anchor
title: Missouri's gerrymandered map will not be on ballot, judge rules | State News | columbiamissourian.com
text:
JEFFERSON CITY — Missouri Secretary of State Denny Hoskins’ decision not to certify a referendum petition that would force a statewide vote on Missouri’s gerrymandered congressional map was lawful, a Cole County circuit judge ruled Wednesday afternoon.
Hoskins on Aug. 4 refused to certify the more than 300,000 signatures to put this on the ballot, claiming the referendum to place it on the ballot was unconstitutional.
Article III, Section 49 of the Missouri Constitution
"The people reserve power to propose and enact or reject laws and amendments to the constitution by the initiative, independent of the general assembly, and also reserve power to approve or reject by referendum any act of the general assembly."
